description: Creates a VPC endpoint for an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline, enabling private connectivity between your VPC and the pipeline.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the pipeline endpoint.
Arn.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the pipeline endpoint.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Pattern: ^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov|aws-iso|aws-iso-b):osis:.+:endpoint/.+$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

EndpointId.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline endpoint.
EndpointId.markdownDescription:
The unique identifier of the pipeline endpoint.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 3  
Maximum Length: 512  
Pattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

PipelineArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the pipeline to create the endpoint for.
PipelineArn.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the pipeline to create the endpoint for.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 46  
Maximum Length: 76  
Pattern: ^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov|aws-iso|aws-iso-b):osis:.+:pipeline/.+$  
Update requires: Replacement
